title: Carry praise, not counterfeit profit
summary: This meets the buyer's instinct to secure the self with goods that cannot stay. The line says take the merchandise of praise, the only wealth that survives the crossing.
takeaway: Carry the profit that can travel.
lifeApplication: Before the next purchase or ambition spike, ask what here can still travel with you. Choose the gain that does not rot into falsehood.

source.shortMeaning: Lasting merchandise is praise that can travel beyond visible profit.
source.lifeApplication: At the point of purchase, ask whether this gain can travel with you.
